inv.desc_en:
COMMERCIAL SPACE FOR RENT ON AVENIDA DE LAS CIENCIAS – PARQUE REY BUILDING

If you are looking for a functional space, well-located and ready to start working from day one, this is your opportunity.

Ideal for both starting entrepreneurs and businesses looking for a new location in a dynamic area.

Avenida de las Ciencias – a consolidated area with constant pedestrian and vehicle traffic, surrounded by shops, services, and daily activity.

Open-plan and versatile space
Easy adaptation to different activities
Air conditioning installed
Private bathroom
Ready to move in
Previously an optician's shop.

A versatile size that adapts to multiple activities: professional office, beauty center, clinic, specialty store, office, academy, or services.

Contact us now and schedule your visit. Your next business could start here.
